data.name: Golden Gate Park Electric Bike Tour
data.headline: E-bike • 3 Hours • $69/adults, $39/teens
data.description:
Bike the Bridge to Sausalito is an unforgettable adventure!

We start at Fisherman’s Wharf and ride along the bay, across the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito – an experience you’ll never forget.

Pedal past sea lions, historic piers, fort Mason, the Marina District, and Crissy Field. then ride across the world-famous Golden Gate Bridge — with sweeping views of the city skyline, Alcatraz, and the Pacific. Once across, coast down into the charming seaside town of Sausalito, known for its waterfront restaurants, local boutiques, and relaxed coastal vibe.

When you’re ready, hop on the ferry back to San Francisco, tickets sold separately. this tour is the must-do adventure of a lifetime

● Riding time: 1.5 hours (8 miles/13 kilometers)
● Sightseeing time in Sausalito: 1 hour with option to extend
● Ferry Ride Back: 30 minutes

Departs daily from 288 Beach Street, San Francisco CA 94133
The morning tour departure time is at 10am, return by 1:00pm. You will have the option to extend your stay in Sausalito for $10 extra.
The afternoon tour departure time is at 2pm, return by 5:00pm
data.cancellation_notes:
Bike & Roll requires 72 hours notice prior to the rental/tour reservation start date/time. A 10% service charge will be deducted from the total reservation amount. Refund processing can take up to 30 days. No refunds are issued for reservations cancelled with less than 72 hours notice, however you may request a Bike & Roll credit and reschedule for another date. Travel delays and other emergencies do not qualify for refunds, but if you contact us prior to start date/time we will issue a Bike & Roll credit that can be used
towards a rental or tour on another date. If a rental or tour reservation is canceled by Bike & Roll due to rain or any other reason, customers can choose to reschedule or request a full refund.
